summary.headline: Planetary House Judgments
summary.text: Astrological judgments for a planet in the houses of Venus, Mercury, and the Moon, linking these placements with luxury, crime, intellect, theft, writing, bodily illness, and harm to the mother. Chapter 42 begins with the Sun in its own house and the other planets.
